@page "/document-editor/content-navigation"

@using Syncfusion.Blazor.Buttons;
@using Syncfusion.Blazor.Inputs
@using BlazorSamples.DocumentData;
@using Syncfusion.Blazor.DropDowns;
@using Syncfusion.Blazor.DocumentEditor;
@*Hidden:Lines*@
@inherits SampleBaseComponent
@*End:Hidden*@

<SampleDescription>
    <p>This example demonstrates how to highlight content in a DOCX editor and navigate between highlighted occurrences through an interactive content navigation experience.</p>
</SampleDescription>
<ActionDescription>
    <p> This example showcases content navigation capabilities in the Document Editor, including:</p>
    
    <p><strong>Key Features</strong></p>
        <ul>
            <li> Find and highlight content in the document.</li>
            <li> Create bookmarks and navigate between findings.</li>
            <li> View findings with page numbers and previews in a dedicated pane.</li>
        </ul>
    
    <p><strong>Documentation Links</strong></p>
    <ul>
    <li><p style="display: block;">
        <a target="_blank" href="https://help.syncfusion.com/document-processing/word/word-processor/blazor/bookmark#select-and-navigate-to-a-bookmark" rel="noopener noreferrer">
        Content Navigation in Blazor DOCX Editor</a></p>
    </li>
    <li><p style="display: block;">
        <a target="_blank" href="https://help.syncfusion.com/cr/document-processing/Syncfusion.Blazor.DocumentEditor.SfDocumentEditor.html" rel="noopener noreferrer">
        API Reference</a></p>
    </li>
    </ul>
    <p style="display: block;">Looking for the full Blazor DOCX Editor overview, features, pricing, and documentation? Visit the 
        <a target="_blank" href="https://www.syncfusion.com/docx-editor-sdk/blazor-docx-editor" rel="noopener noreferrer">
        Blazor DOCX Editor</a> page.</p>

</ActionDescription>
    
<div class="control-section">
    <div>
        <div class="col-lg-9 control-section">
            <div id='documenteditor_titlebar' class="e-de-ctn-title">
                <div class="single-line" id="documenteditor_title_contentEditor" style="border: 1px solid transparent;" title="Document Name." contenteditable="false">
                    <label id="documenteditor_title_name" class="doc-edit-title"> @DocumentName</label>
                </div>
                <div style="float: right">
                    <SfButton IconCss="e-de-icon-Print" CssClass="title-bar-btn" @onclick="Print">Print</SfButton>
                </div>
                <div style="float: right">
                    <SfButton IconCss="e-de-icon-Download" CssClass="title-bar-btn" @onclick="OnExport">Download</SfButton>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div style="display:block; height: calc(100vh - 230px);">
                <SfDocumentEditorContainer @ref="container" Height="100%" ServiceUrl="https://document.syncfusion.com/web-services/docx-editor/api/documenteditor/"  RestrictEditing="@ReadOnly" ShowPropertiesPane="@ShowProperties" ToolbarItems="@Items">
                    <DocumentEditorContainerEvents Created="OnCreated" DocumentChanged="OnDocumentChange" ></DocumentEditorContainerEvents>
                </SfDocumentEditorContainer>
            </div>
        </div>
        <div class="col-lg-3">
            <aside class="findings-panel" aria-label="Document content navigation">
                <h3>Findings in document</h3>

                <div class="hits-count" id="hitsCount">
                    <b>@findings.Count hits</b>
                </div>

                <div class="divider"></div>

                @if (findings.Count == 0)
                {
                    <div class="empty-findings">
                        No matching content was found.
                    </div>
                }

                @foreach (var i in findings.Select((item, index) => new { item, index }))
                {
                    <div class="finding-card @(activeIndex == i.index ? "active" : "")"
                        role="button"
                        tabindex="0"
                        aria-label="@($"Navigate to finding on page {i.item.PageNumber}")"
                        aria-current="@(activeIndex == i.index ? "true" : null)"
                        @onclick="() => NavigateToBookmark(i.item.Bookmark, i.index)"
                        @onkeydown="@(e => HandleFindingKeyDown(e, i.item.Bookmark, i.index))">

                        <span class="finding-indicator"
                            style="background-color: @i.item.Color"
                            aria-hidden="true">
                        </span>

                        <div class="result-page">
                            Page @i.item.PageNumber
                        </div>

                        <div class="result-highlight">
                            @i.item.Preview
                        </div>
                    </div>
                }

                <button type="button"
                        class="action-button"
                        disabled="@(findings.Count == 0)"
                        @onclick="NextHighlight">
                    Next Highlight
                </button>
            </aside>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>


@code {
    private List<Finding> findings = new();    
    List<Object> Items = new List<Object> { "Redo", "Separator", "Image", "Table", "Hyperlink", "Bookmark", "TableOfContents", "Separator", "Header", "Footer", "PageSetup", "PageNumber", "Break", "InsertFootnote", "InsertEndnote", "Separator", "Find", "Separator", "Comments", "TrackChanges", "Separator", "LocalClipboard", "RestrictEditing", "Separator", "FormFields", "UpdateFields" };
    internal string? DocumentName { get; set; } = "Content Navigation";
    internal bool ReadOnly { get; set; }
    internal bool ShowProperties { get; set; }
    private int activeIndex = -1;
    private bool bookmarksCreated = false;    
    private CancellationTokenSource? createBookmarksCts;
    private SfDocumentEditorContainer? container;

    /// <summary>
    /// Represents an item displayed in the findings panel.
    /// </summary>
    public class Finding
    {
        public string Bookmark { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public int PageNumber { get; set; }
        public string Preview { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public string Color { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Represents predefined content that must be located inside the document.
    /// </summary>
    public class ParagraphDefinition
    {
        public string Bookmark { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public string Text { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public string Color { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Paragraphs that will be searched, highlighted,
    /// bookmarked, and displayed in the findings panel.
    /// </summary>
    private static readonly List<ParagraphDefinition> PARAGRAPHS = new()
    {
        new ParagraphDefinition
        {
            Bookmark = "Para_Bookmark_1",
            Text = "The giant panda, which only lives in China outside of captivity, " +
                   "has captured the hearts of people of all ages across the globe.",
            Color = "#ec4899"
        },

        new ParagraphDefinition
        {
            Bookmark = "Para_Bookmark_2",
            Text = "DNA analysis has put one mystery to rest. It has revealed that " +
                   "while the red panda is a distant relation, the giant panda's closest " +
                   "relative is the spectacled bear from South America.",
            Color = "#3b82f6"
        },

        new ParagraphDefinition
        {
            Bookmark = "Para_Bookmark_3",
            Text = "Researchers have recently discovered that the gene responsible " +
                   "for tasting savory or umami flavors, such as meat, is inactive in giant pandas.",
            Color = "#22c55e"
        }
    };

    /// <summary>
    /// Navigates to a bookmark selected from the findings panel.
    /// </summary>
    private async Task NavigateToBookmark(string bookmark, int index)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(bookmark))
        {
            return;
        }

        // Syncfusion Document Editor instance.
        var editor = container.DocumentEditor;

        if (editor == null)
        {
            return;
        }

        // Select the bookmark in the document editor.
        await editor.Selection.SelectBookmarkAsync(bookmark);

        // Set focus back to the document editor.
        await editor.FocusAsync();

        // Mark the selected finding as active.
        activeIndex = index;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Navigates to the next highlighted finding.
    /// </summary>
    private async Task NextHighlight()
    {
        if (findings == null || findings.Count == 0)
        {
            return;
        }

        var nextIndex = (activeIndex + 1) % findings.Count;

        var nextFinding = findings[nextIndex];

        await NavigateToBookmark(nextFinding.Bookmark, nextIndex);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Creates the shortened text displayed in the findings panel.
    /// </summary>
    private string GetPreview(string text)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text))
        {
            return string.Empty;
        }

        var words = text.Trim()
                        .Split(
                            new[] { ' ', '\t', '\r', '\n' },
                            StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);

        var preview = string.Join(" ", words.Take(8));

        return words.Length > 8
            ? $"{preview}..."
            : preview;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Handles keyboard navigation for a finding.
    /// </summary>
    private Task HandleFindingKeyDown(
        KeyboardEventArgs e,
        string bookmark,
        int index)
    {
        if (e.Key == "Enter" || e.Key == " ")
        {
            return NavigateToBookmark(bookmark, index);
        }

        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    public void OnExport(object args)
    {
        if (container != null)
        {
            SfDocumentEditor documentEditor = container.DocumentEditor;
            documentEditor.SaveAsync(DocumentName, FormatType.Docx);
        }

    }

    public void Print(object args)
    {
        if (container != null)
        {
            SfDocumentEditor documentEditor = container.DocumentEditor;
            documentEditor.PrintAsync();
        }
    }

    public async void OnCreated(object args)
    {
        if (container != null)
        {
            SfDocumentEditor documentEditor = container.DocumentEditor;
            if (documentEditor != null)
            {
                await documentEditor.OpenAsync(Data.WebLayout);
                DocumentName = "Content Navigation";

                if (SampleService.IsDevice)
                {
                    ReadOnly = true;
                    ShowProperties = false;
                    await documentEditor.FitPageAsync(PageFitType.FitPageWidth);
                }
            }
        }
    }

       /// <summary>
    /// Finds the predefined paragraphs, highlights them,
    /// creates bookmarks, and populates the findings panel.
    /// </summary>
    private async Task CreateBookmarks()
    {
        var editor = container.DocumentEditor;

        if (editor == null || bookmarksCreated)
        {
            return;
        }

        var results = new List<Finding>();

        foreach (var paragraph in PARAGRAPHS)
        {
            await editor.Search.FindAllAsync(paragraph.Text);

            var searchResults = editor.Search.SearchResults;

            if (await searchResults.GetLengthAsync() > 0)
            {
                searchResults.SetIndexAsync(0);

                var pageNumber = await editor.Selection.GetStartPageAsync();

                editor.Selection.CharacterFormat.SetHighlightColorAsync(HighlightColor.Yellow);

                editor.Editor.InsertBookmarkAsync(paragraph.Bookmark);

                results.Add(new Finding
                {
                    Bookmark = paragraph.Bookmark,
                    PageNumber = pageNumber,
                    Preview = GetPreview(paragraph.Text),
                    Color = paragraph.Color
                });
            }

            await searchResults.ClearAsync();
        }

        await editor.Selection.MoveToDocumentStartAsync();        

        findings = results;

        activeIndex = results.Count > 0 ? 0 : -1;

        bookmarksCreated = true;
        
        ReadOnly = true;

        editor.ResizeAsync();
    }


    /// <summary>
    /// Executes whenever the document is opened or changed.
    /// </summary>
    private async Task OnDocumentChange()
    {

        // Keep focus on the document editor.
        container.DocumentEditor.FocusAsync();

        if (bookmarksCreated)
        {
            return;
        }

        // Cancel the previously scheduled bookmark creation.
        createBookmarksCts?.Cancel();
        createBookmarksCts?.Dispose();

        createBookmarksCts = new CancellationTokenSource();

        try
        {
            // Wait 500 ms before creating bookmarks.
            await Task.Delay(500, createBookmarksCts.Token);

            if (!createBookmarksCts.IsCancellationRequested &&
                !bookmarksCreated)
            {
                await CreateBookmarks();
            }
        }
        catch (TaskCanceledException)
        {
            // A newer document change occurred before the timer elapsed.
        }
    }

}


<style>
        .flex-container {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: flex-end;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 4px;
        }

        .render-mode-info {
            padding-left: 0;
            background: none;
            border: none;
        }

        .render-mode-info .render-mode-info-icon {
            width: 16px;
            height: 16px;
        }

        .render-mode-info .render-mode-info-icon::before {
            line-height: normal;
        }

        .switchLabel {
            margin-bottom: 0;
            font-family:
                "Segoe UI",
                "GeezaPro",
                "DejaVu Serif",
                sans-serif;
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: 400;
            line-height: 20px;
            letter-spacing: 0.24px;
        }

        .buttonSwitch {
            width: 40px;
            height: 24px;
        }

        .content-navigation-layout {
            display: flex;
            align-items: stretch;
            width: 100%;
        }

        .document-editor-section {
            flex: 1 1 auto;
            min-width: 0;
        }

        #content_navigation_title_bar {
            box-sizing: border-box;
            width: 100%;
            height: 36px;
            padding-right: 10px;
            padding-left: 15px;
            font-family: inherit;
            font-size: 12px;
            line-height: 26px;
        }

        .single-line {
            cursor: text !important;
            outline: none;
        }

        .findings-panel {
            box-sizing: border-box;
            display: flex;
            flex: 0 0 300px;
            flex-direction: column;
            width: 100%;
            height: calc(100vh - 150px);
            padding: 28px 20px;
            overflow-y: auto;
            border-left: 1px solid #e5e7eb;
        }

        .findings-panel h3 {
            margin: 0;
            color: inherit;
            font-size: 18px;
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        .hits-count {
            margin-top: 12px;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            font-size: 14px;
        }

        .divider {
            flex: 0 0 auto;
            height: 1px;
            margin-bottom: 12px;
            background: #e5e7eb;
        }

        .empty-findings {
            padding: 20px 0;
            font-size: 14px;
        }

        .finding-card {
            position: relative;
            margin-bottom: 18px;
            padding: 14px 12px 18px 18px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid #e5e7eb;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition:
                background-color 0.2s ease,
                border-radius 0.2s ease;
        }

        .finding-card:last-of-type {
            border-bottom: none;
        }

        .finding-card:hover {
            border-radius: 8px;
        }

        .finding-card:focus-visible {
            border-radius: 8px;
            outline: none;
            box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #2563eb;
        }

        .finding-card.active {
            background: rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.15);
            border-radius: 8px;
        }

        .finding-indicator {
            position: absolute;
            top: 14px;
            left: 0;
            width: 4px;
            height: 48px;
            border-radius: 4px;
        }

        .result-page {
            margin-bottom: 6px;
            font-size: 18px;
            font-weight: 700;
        }

        .result-highlight {
            font-size: 14px;
            line-height: 20px;
            letter-spacing: 0.3px;

            display: -webkit-box;
            line-clamp: 2;
            -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
            -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .action-button {
            width: 100%;
            min-height: 52px;
            margin-top: auto;
            font-size: 16px;
            color: #374151;
            border: 1px solid #d1d5db;
            border-radius: 10px;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition:
                background-color 0.2s ease,
                border-color 0.2s ease;
        }

        #edit_container {
        width: 950px;
    }

    .title-bar-btn, .title-bar-btn:hover, .title-bar-btn:focus {
        background: transparent;
        box-shadow: none;
        font-family: inherit;
        border-color: transparent;
        border-radius: 2px;
        color: inherit;
        font-size: 12px;
        text-transform: capitalize;
        height: 28px;
        font-weight: 400;
        margin-top: 2px;
    }

    #documenteditor_titlebar {
        border-bottom: 1px solid #3f51b5;
        height: 36px;
        line-height: 26px;
        width: 100%;
        font-size: 12px;
        padding-left: 15px;
        padding-right: 10px;
        font-family: inherit;
    }

    #documenteditor_title_contentEditor {
        height: 26px;
        max-width: 85%;
        width: auto;
        overflow: hidden;
        display: inline-block;
        padding-left: 4px;
        padding-right: 4px;
        margin: 5px;
    }

    .doc-edit-title {
        text-transform: capitalize;
        font-weight: 400;
        font-family: inherit;
        text-overflow: ellipsis;
        outline: none;
        white-space: pre;
        overflow: hidden;
        user-select: none;
        cursor: text
    }

    .single-line {
        cursor: text !important;
        outline: none;
    }

    /*.single-line:hover, .single-line:focus {
            border-color: #e4e4e4 !important;
        }*/

    [contenteditable="true"].single-line {
        white-space: nowrap;
        border-color: #e4e4e4 !important;
    }


    /** Document editor sample level font icons*/

    @@font-face {
        font-family: 'Sample brower icons';
        src: url(data:application/x-font-ttf;charset=utf-8;base64,) format('truetype');
        font-weight: normal;
        font-style: normal;
    }

    [class^="e-de-icon-"],
    [class*=" e-de-icon-"] {
        font-family: 'Sample brower icons' !important;
    }

    .e-de-icon-Print:before {
        content: "\e723";
        font-family: 'Sample brower icons' !important;
    }

    .e-de-icon-Download:before {
        content: "\e728";
        font-family: 'Sample brower icons' !important;
    }

    .print-ctnr {
        cursor: pointer;
        margin-top: 6px;
    }

    </style>
